body.name: active-system plug-in map
body.construction: For active scenario rows \(\mathcal I=\mathcal I_x(p_x)\) and positive policy coordinates \(\mathcal J=\mathcal J_x(p_x)\), order \(u_x=(q_{x,\mathcal J}^*,v_x,\lambda_{\mathcal I},\eta_x)\) and set \[H_x(p_x)=\begin{bmatrix}G_{\mathcal I,\mathcal J}(p_x)&-\mathbf 1_{\mathcal I}&0&0\\0&0&G_{\mathcal I,\mathcal J}(p_x)^\top&-\mathbf 1_{\mathcal J}\\\mathbf 1_{\mathcal J}^\top&0&0&0\\0&0&\mathbf 1_{\mathcal I}^\top&0\end{bmatrix},\qquad g_x(p_x)=\begin{bmatrix}0_{\mathcal I}\\0_{\mathcal J}\\1\\1\end{bmatrix}.\] Solve \(H_x(p_x)u_x(p_x)=g_x(p_x)\), zero-pad through \(E_x(p_x)\), and define \(J_x(p_x)[h]=-E_x(p_x)H_x(p_x)^{-1}DH_x(p_x)[h]u_x(p_x)\).
